def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    n,m=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            rr,cc=n-1-r,m-1-c
            if grid[r][c]==3:
                out[r][c] = grid[rr][cc] if grid[rr][cc] != 3 else 6
    return out
